artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the book spines is largely illegible or pseudo-text. While some characters resemble Japanese Kanji or Katakana, many spines show melted, distorted, or nonsensical character structures typical of AI generation failing to render small, dense text accurately. It is not 'clean' text.

The edges of the books (the page blocks) lack the fine linear texture of individual paper pages. They appear as smooth, smeared gradients or solid blocks of color rather than distinct pages. This is a subtle but common AI artifact in book rendering.

The books on the far right of the bottom visible shelf seem to merge into the background/shelf edge without clear boundaries. The geometry of the last few spines is ambiguous and slightly warped, lacking the rigid rectangular prism shape expected of physical books.
